description: Khorena wears a full-length dark blue gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length outer sleeves. Cream underlayer cloth shows below the outer sleeves and near the lower skirt. Tan geometric embroidered or woven borders run across the neckline, front panels and sleeves. A woven belt with two round metal fittings and a tasseled hanging end defines the waist. A blue-grey and cream patterned wool-like wrap rests loosely around the arms rather than covering the neckline. A small round pendant hangs at her upper chest. Dark closed shoes are visible beneath the hem. Fabric is substantial and opaque, with exact fiber uncertain; no headgear, armor or weapon appears.
